parameters.text: This is a scanned CV. Transcribe ALL of its text exactly as written (OCR). Return plain text only, no commentary.

attributes.name: yearsExperience
attributes.description: Total years of relevant professional experience (decimal allowed, e.g. 1.1)

attributes.name: topSkills
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of the candidate's top technical skills

attributes.name: education
attributes.description: Highest degree and field of study

messageValues.message: You are a strict, fair technical recruiter. Score the candidate against the job description from 0 to 100. Recommendation rules: score >= 75 -> 'interview'; 50-74 -> 'maybe'; below 50 -> 'reject'. List matched_requirements and missing_requirements using the job's wording. Base everything only on the CV evidence. Provide exactly 3 tailored interview_questions.

parameters.subject: =Interview invitation - {{ $json.position }}
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $json.name }},

Thank you for applying for the {{ $json.position }} position. We were impressed by your profile and would like to invite you to an interview.

Please reply to this email with your availability over the next few days.

Best regards,
HR Team

Score: {{ $json.score }}/100 - recommendation: maybe

Strengths: {{ $json.strengths }}

parameters.subject: =Your application - {{ $json.position }}
parameters.message:
=

Hi {{ $json.name }},

Thank you for your interest in the {{ $json.position }} role and for the time you invested in applying. After careful review, we have decided not to move forward at this time.

We will keep your details on file and wish you every success.

Best regards,
HR Team
